title: Local models
text: Agents, assistants and knowledge search can run on this computer with local models (Ollama), without an API key. Data stays here.

mode.managed: Managed by Nodestro on this computer
mode.container: Model container of Nodestro Local Docker

serverManaged: On this server the operator runs the local model server. You can see the installed models here.
unavailable: No local model server is configured. Enter the address of an Ollama server for the Ollama provider below.
detected: An Ollama server is already running at {{url}}. Nodestro uses it only if you save this address for the Ollama provider.

runtime.missing: The local model runtime (Ollama {{version}}) is not installed yet. Download it once, or install it offline from its release archive.
runtime.archiveHint: The archive of the pinned version (for example ollama-linux-amd64.tar.zst). Its SHA-256 is checked before installing.

hardware: This computer: {{cpus}} CPU cores, {{ram}} memory, graphics: {{gpu}}

recommend.title: Recommended for this computer
recommend.text: Suggestions based on the task, the memory of this computer and the installed models. You choose the model of each agent yourself; nothing is changed automatically.

reasons.below_ideal: A larger model would do this better.
reasons.hardware_limit: This computer has too little memory for a larger model.
reasons.no_gpu: Without a graphics card, large models are too slow.
reasons.no_fit: No suggested model fits this computer.
reasons.preferred_region_unavailable: No equally suitable model of your preferred origin.
reasons.languages_unverified: No model documents all languages of this work.

import.title: Offline import
import.pathHint: A path on the computer that runs Nodestro (in Local Docker: inside its import folder). Packages are checked by SHA-256.
import.name: Model name
import.nameHint: The name agents use, for example my-model:q4.
import.projectorHint: The mmproj file, if the model reads images.

storage.title: Model folder
storage.pathHint: An absolute path, for example on an external SSD.
storage.copy: Copy them there and check them
storage.use: Use the folder as it is
storage.copying: The models are being copied. The old folder is kept.

offline.label: Strict offline mode
offline.text: Only local models and local tools. Cloud models, remote servers and downloads are refused before a run starts.
offline.noDownloads: Downloads are off in the strict offline mode.

europe.label: Prefer European models
europe.text: Among equally suited local models, suggest those of European publishers (Mistral AI). Qwen stays the standard otherwise. A model you choose yourself always wins, and nothing is sent to a cloud service.

search.title: Knowledge search
search.text: How agents find sections in their knowledge files. Semantic search finds matching passages by meaning, also across languages.

modeHint.fts: Finds the words of the question. Needs no model.
modeHint.vector: Finds passages by meaning. Needs the semantic index.
modeHint.hybrid: Combines full text and meaning. Needs the semantic index.

search.embeddingHint: Another model needs a new index. Searches keep using the current index until the new one is complete.

state.incomplete: Sections indexed: {{embedded}} of {{chunks}}. Rebuild to add the rest.
state.reindex_required: The chosen model differs from the index. Rebuild the index for it.
state.unavailable: The model server cannot be reached.

index.needed: Semantic and combined search need a complete index. Until then, runs that use them do not start.

build.title: Build from local files
build.text: This model is not in the Ollama library. Nodestro builds it on this computer from its original files, without internet: it checks both files against their pinned SHA-256 checksums, builds the model and keeps it only if it reproduces the reference vectors exactly.
build.expected: Expected files (copy them from a computer with internet, for example to a USB drive):
build.expectedUnlisted: Two pinned files are needed: the weights (safetensors) and a template GGUF file, {{size}} together. The manual lists their sources and checksums.
build.weightsHint: A path on the computer that runs Nodestro (in Local Docker: inside its import folder), for example /media/usb/model.safetensors.
build.templateHint: The whole template GGUF file, or only its first {{size}} (the header).
build.offlineNote: Nothing is downloaded: the build uses only these two files.

steps.create: creating the model in the model server

build.reindex: To use it for semantic search, choose it as the embedding model under Knowledge search and rebuild the index. The current index stays in use until the new one is complete.
build.reindexActive: {{model}} is the chosen embedding model: rebuild the index under Knowledge search so that searches use it.

errors.cancelled: The build was canceled. Nothing was installed.
errors.checksum_mismatch: The {{name}} does not match the pinned checksum. Nothing was installed.
errors.checksum_mismatchHint: Check that it is exactly the expected file in the expected version (see above) and that the copy is complete, then try again.
errors.source_missingHint: Check the path. It must name a file on the computer that runs Nodestro (in Local Docker: inside its import folder).
errors.invalid_template: The template file is not a compatible GGUF file for this model.
errors.invalid_templateHint: Use the template file named above, not another GGUF file.
errors.invalid_weights: The weights file is not compatible with this model.
errors.invalid_weightsHint: Use the safetensors file of the named revision.
errors.reference_mismatch: The built model does not reproduce the reference vectors and was removed again.
errors.reference_mismatchHint: The files were correct, but the model server computes different vectors. Check that the model server has the pinned version, then try again.
